Rooftop Dining & Drinks

Unwind with Skyline Views & Cozy Ambiance

Unwind with stunning views and a cozy ambiance at our Rooftop Bar and Restaurant. From our barman creating classic curated cocktails to savoury bites, each dish is thoughtfully crafted to elevate your experience.

Whether you're here to relax, socialize, or host a gathering, we offer a space where memories are made. Its distinct spaces let you enjoy a romantic dinner date at the same time as your friends gear up for a night of partying.
